title: Measurable moduli for first-order remainders of a Lipschitz function
statement: For all n ∈ ℕ and K ∈ ℝ≥0, every set C ⊆ ℝⁿ, every K-Lipschitz f : ℝⁿ → ℝ and every Borel map ν : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ, there are Borel functions η_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) with two properties. (i) For all k and all x, y ∈ C with 0 < |y − x| < 1/(k+1), |f(y) − f(x) − ⟨ν(x), y − x⟩| ≤ η_k(x)|y − x|. (ii) If x ∈ C and f is Fréchet differentiable at x with derivative v ↦ ⟨ν(x), v⟩ (HasFDerivAt f (innerSL ℝ (ν x)) x), then η_k(x) → 0 as k → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : ℝ≥0) (C : Set (Rn n)) (f : Rn n → ℝ) (ν : Rn n → Rn n), LipschitzWith K f → Measurable ν → ∃ η : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ, (∀ k, Measurable (η k)) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, 0 < ‖y - x‖ → ‖y - x‖ < 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) → |f y - f x - inner ℝ (ν x) (y - x)| ≤ η k x * ‖y - x‖) ∧ ∀ x ∈ C, HasFDerivAt f (innerSL ℝ (ν x)) x → Tendsto (fun k ↦ η k x) atTop (𝓝 0)
